# XAA Hackathon Kit

> A spec-first prompt kit for building a Cross-App Access (XAA)
> Requesting App against the public xaa.dev playground — in any
> language or framework. Implements OIDC + PKCE login, RFC 8693 token
> exchange, RFC 7523 jwt-bearer, and RFC 6750 bearer error mapping.

The kit at `hackathon-kit/` is the authoritative spec. AI coding agents
should start at `hackathon-kit/IGNITION.md`. The three target hosts are
fixed: `https://idp.xaa.dev`, `https://auth.resource.xaa.dev`,
`https://api.resource.xaa.dev`.

## Entry points

- [IGNITION.md](hackathon-kit/IGNITION.md): Paste-into-agent runbook for Codex / Claude Code / Cursor / Aider with filesystem access.
- [Chat-only ignition](hackathon-kit/ignition/chat-only.md): Copy-paste ignition flow for ChatGPT browser and tools without filesystem access.
- [README.md](hackathon-kit/README.md): Developer help doc — what you can build with the kit, the stack picker, and Day-0 checklist.
- [Task brief (00)](hackathon-kit/00-brief.md): The "what we're building" spec for the AI's first context message.

## Numbered prompts (execute in order)

- [01 — Project skeleton](hackathon-kit/01-project-skeleton.md): Stack scaffold, env config, session adapter, logger.
- [02 — OIDC login](hackathon-kit/02-oidc-login.md): Authorization Code + PKCE S256, state + nonce, server-side session.
- [03 — Token exchange](hackathon-kit/03-token-exchange.md): RFC 8693 token-exchange to ID-JAG, then RFC 7523 jwt-bearer to access token.
- [04 — Protected resource call](hackathon-kit/04-protected-resource-call.md): Bearer call + WWW-Authenticate decoding + ErrorCode mapping.
- [05 — UI and observability](hackathon-kit/05-ui-and-observability.md): Dashboard, redacted token surface, request timeline.
- [06 — Debugging playbook](hackathon-kit/06-debugging-playbook.md): Thirteen failure shapes with diagnostic prompts (reference, not a step).
- [07 — Testing](hackathon-kit/07-testing.md): T1–T5 hermetic + B1–B9 smoke + E1–E5 manual scenarios.

## Reference

- [Glossary](hackathon-kit/reference/glossary.md): Terminology anchors — Identities, Tokens, Wire-format pieces, XAA-specific terms.
- [Env vars](hackathon-kit/reference/env-vars.md): Three fixed hosts + nine per-developer credentials, with registration walkthrough.
- [XAA spec](hackathon-kit/reference/xaa-spec.md): Canonical wire format for both grants — exact form fields, audience semantics.
- [Error mapping](hackathon-kit/reference/error-mapping.md): ErrorCode set + WWW-Authenticate + token-exchange decoding tables.
- [Architecture](hackathon-kit/reference/architecture.md): Flow diagrams for the four hops and the two-client pattern.

## Repo-root agent files

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Auto-loaded by Codex / Cursor — invariants digest.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Auto-loaded by Claude Code — invariants digest.
- [.cursorrules](.cursorrules): Cursor project rules.
- [.env.example](.env.example): Env-var template — copy to `.env.local` and fill in.
